propositions: Rebar reconciler hardcodes Jira project mappings in multiple files, preventing support for projects with variant workflows without core code edits.

The mapping seam must be provider-neutral and config-driven, reading from rebar.toml with layered precedence (built-in default → config default → per-project overlay), supporting status, type, link relations, priority, and parent relationships.
A rebar type with no target analogue must be collapsible (via rebar-type: label) or skipped (whole-ticket exclusion), with unmapped-non-skipped types failing closed at config load.
Non-allowed transitions are attempted via replay of the ticket's recorded STATUS event log, falling back to drift when no trail survives (e.g., compacted tickets).
Non-representable parent relationships drift and leave an echo-safe breadcrumb comment naming the nearest represented ancestor's Jira key.
Required-field create failures are prevented by a per-project create_defaults config block, and live-drift is detected by rebar doctor and suggested via rebar bridge suggest-mapping.
